questions.explain: sys.dm_os_wait_stats is cumulative since service restart, so the chapter stresses computing deltas over the collection window (15-second intervals) rather than using point-in-time snapshots.
options: They reset at midnight automatically
The values are cumulative since service restart, so deltas must be computed
DMVs are deprecated in SQL Server 2022
Wait stats are only available on Enterprise edition
questions.q: Why does the chapter insist on computing deltas from sys.dm_os_wait_stats rather than using point-in-time snapshots?

questions.explain: The regression detector flags queries where the active plan averages more than 2x the best known plan's duration, weighted by execution frequency — and also guards against auto-forcing when regression exceeds 10x or impact is low.
options: Forced plans cannot be unforced
Only DBAs may call sp_query_store_force_plan
A >2x regression threshold, execution-frequency weighting, stats-freshness validation, and refusing to auto-force regressions >10x
Automatic tuning must be disabled first
questions.q: What combination of safeguards does the autonomous Query Store query governor apply before forcing a plan?

questions.explain: The chapter calls this out explicitly: ALTER AVAILABILITY GROUP ... FAILOVER must be issued from the target secondary, not the primary — which is why the controller requires secondary connection strings.
options: It must be issued from the current primary
It must be issued from the target secondary
It must be issued from a quorum voter
It can be issued from any replica
questions.q: When the autonomous AG controller initiates a manual failover, which replica must the FAILOVER statement be executed from?

questions.explain: The fragmentation assessment query recommends SKIP under 1000 pages or <5% fragmentation, REORGANIZE for 5-30%, and REBUILD above 30%; the autonomous manager also budgets within a maintenance window.
options: SKIP below 1000 pages or under 5% fragmentation; REORGANIZE 5-30%; REBUILD above 30%
Always rebuild everything nightly
Reorganize everything; never rebuild online
SKIP if fragmentation is above 50%
questions.q: What are the autonomous index maintenance decision thresholds in the fragmentation assessment?

questions.explain: The unified controller implements CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW priority ordering, mutual exclusion via a critical lock, cooldowns, and writes every action to dba.autonomy_audit.
options: Running all subsystems on independent fixed schedules
A unified control plane with priority hierarchy, mutual exclusion, cooldowns, and a single audit table
Letting WSFC arbitrate all actions
Disabling all but one subsystem
questions.q: How does the chapter require the autonomous subsystems (Query Store governor, AG controller, index manager, Resource Governor tuner) to be composed in production?
